reasons: The lake identity record confirms Hafer v. Melo as a U.S. Supreme Court case decided 1991-11-05 with docket No. 90-681 and cluster_id 112657.
The lake citations record lists the official cite 502 U.S. 21 and the same parallel/vendor-neutral citations shown on the page.
No disclosed treatment or progeny edge supersedes, overrules, abrogates, or limits the authority; the page separately discloses treatment as unverified.
residual_risks: The disclosed record does not affirmatively verify live-law status because treatment is marked unverified and progeny is empty.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the treatment-unverified warning until a citator/progeny pass supplies an as-of date.

reasons: Lens B does not assess support or quote fidelity.
From the currency angle, the disclosed lake record contains no negative treatment edge contradicting the holding statement, and the page labels treatment as unverified.
residual_risks: Substantive holding support is reserved for Lens A; current good-law status remains unverified in the disclosed treatment fields.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Do not remove the unverified-treatment display unless treatment/progeny fields are populated.

reasons: Lens B does not assess editorial support for the home-role assignment.
No disclosed treatment or progeny field makes the Anchor role false on currency grounds; the page discloses the case's treatment as unverified.
residual_risks: The Anchor label is not independently validated by a treatment derivation; it should not be read as a verified good-law signal.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Consider separating editorial role from any implied current-validity signal.

reasons: The lake identity record lists court as U.S. Supreme Court and court_level as scotus.
A Supreme Court authority supports the hierarchy label Binding — SCOTUS, and no disclosed negative treatment edge changes that court-weight label.
residual_risks: Binding court weight is not the same as verified current validity; treatment remains unverified.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep court weight visually distinct from treatment status.

reasons: The page treatment fields match the lake treatment fields: field_i_validity unverified, as_of_content null, as_of_treatment null, composite_basis unverified, varies_by_point false, and the frontier-stub scope note.
The disclosed treatment edges and progeny records are empty, so there is no disclosed negative treatment to add.
residual_risks: Because treatment and progeny are unverified, the page cannot make an affirmative good-law claim from the disclosed record.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Populate as_of_treatment, derivation, and progeny edges before changing the status from Unverified.
